# Weight Loss Percentage (https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/)

> Weight Loss Percentage is a client-side clinical calculator suite for tracking total body weight loss percentage, newborn weight loss (AAP guidelines), BMR/TDEE energy expenditure (Mifflin-St Jeor), and body composition—operating entirely in the browser with zero server-side data storage.

## Client-Side Clinical Architecture & Privacy (No Server-Side Data Storage)
- **100% Client-Side Execution**: All biometric calculations—including starting weight, current weight, newborn birth weight, height, age, and body measurements—are computed locally within the user's browser using JavaScript/TypeScript.
- **Zero Server-Side Data Storage**: This application does not use a backend database to store user health inputs, does not transmit personal biometric records to external servers, and requires no user accounts or sign-ups.
- **Clinical Utility**: Designed as a fast, private, medically reviewed reference tool for patients, parents, and healthcare professionals.

## Core Mathematical & Clinical Formulas
1. **Weight Loss Percentage Formula**:
   `Weight Loss % = ((Starting Weight - Current Weight) / Starting Weight) * 100`
2. **Newborn Weight Loss Formula (AAP Protocol)**:
   `Newborn Loss % = ((Birth Weight - Current Weight) / Birth Weight) * 100`
   - Normal physiological diuresis (0–48h): < 7%
   - Clinical observation & lactation evaluation: 7% – 10%
   - Pediatric evaluation alert threshold: > 10%
3. **Basal Metabolic Rate (Mifflin-St Jeor Equation)**:
   - Male: `BMR = (10 * weight_kg) + (6.25 * height_cm) - (5 * age) + 5`
   - Female: `BMR = (10 * weight_kg) + (6.25 * height_cm) - (5 * age) - 161`
4. **Clinical Health Milestones (AHA / ADA / NIH Look AHEAD)**:
   - **5% Total Body Weight Loss**: Clinically meaningful improvements in HbA1c, blood pressure (~5 mmHg reduction), and insulin sensitivity.
   - **10% Total Body Weight Loss**: Significant visceral fat reduction, lipid profile improvement, and obstructive sleep apnea relief.
   - **15%+ Total Body Weight Loss**: Major metabolic improvement and potential remission markers in Type 2 Diabetes.

## Calculator Types & Sections
- [Home & Primary Weight Loss Percentage Calculator](https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/): Instant percentage loss, goal progress, BMI shift, and clinical milestone tracker.
- [Weight Loss Percentage Calculator](https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/calculators/weight-loss/): Dedicated adult total body weight loss percentage analyzer.
- [Newborn Weight Loss Calculator](https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/calculators/newborn-weight-loss/): Postnatal weight tracking in pounds/ounces and grams against AAP 5%, 7%, and 10% thresholds.
- [Baby Weight Loss & Growth Tracker](https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/calculators/baby-weight-loss/): Infant weight recovery and birth-weight regain verification (days 10–14).
- [Infant Weight Loss Calculator](https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/calculators/infant-weight-loss/): Pediatric infant weight change and hydration threshold analyzer.
- [Water Fasting Weight Loss Calculator](https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/calculators/water-fasting-weight-loss/): 24h, 48h, 72h, 5-day, and 7-day water fast modeling separating glycogen water drop from true fat oxidation.
- [OMAD & Intermittent Fasting Weight Loss Calculator](https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/calculators/omad-weight-loss/): 23:1 OMAD and 16:8 intermittent fasting net fat loss and scale weight projections.
- [GLP-1, Semaglutide & Tirzepatide Weight Loss Calculator](https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/calculators/glp1-weight-loss/): STEP-1 (14.9%), SURMOUNT-1 (20.9%), and Phase 2 clinical trial benchmarks with official FDA titration schedules.
- [Bariatric Surgery Weight Loss Calculator](https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/calculators/bariatric-surgery-weight-loss/): Excess Body Weight Loss (%EWL), Total Body Weight Loss (%TBWL), and 1M/3M/6M/12M/18M timeline for VSG, RNY, and Duodenal Switch.
- [Postpartum & Breastfeeding Weight Loss Calculator](https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/calculators/postpartum-weight-loss/): Safe postnatal caloric deficit and lactation-adjusted (+450 kcal/day) timeline planner.
- [BMR & 12-Week Projection Calculator](https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/calculators/bmr/): Mifflin-St Jeor resting energy expenditure and 12-week Losertown-style weight forecast table.

- [Calorie Deficit Weight Loss Calculator](https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/calculators/calorie-deficit/): Daily calorie deficit and weekly fat loss projection planner.

- [Cycling Calorie & Weight Loss Calculator](https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/calculators/cycling/): MET-based cycling energy expenditure and weight loss estimator.
- [Walking Calorie & Weight Loss Calculator](https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/calculators/walking/): Walking energy expenditure based on pace, incline, and body weight.

- [Water Intake Calculator for Weight Loss](https://www.weightlosspercentage.com/calculators/water-intake/): Daily water intake targets based on 30–35 ml per kg of body weight.
